verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API described as a CRUD API for performing console.statsig.com actions without the web UI, and its analytics surface (Metrics Explorer, charts) lives in that console. Nothing in the evidence confirms that dashboards or saved insights are among the Console API's resources, so this is only an implied, unproven extent of a general capability. Missing for 10: documented dashboard and saved-insight endpoints, create/update/delete examples for analytics objects, an OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and hands-on corroboration.
